chapter: Chris Kelly and the dance halls
title: Switching from banjo to guitar and the steel guitar
summary: He got his guitar in 1943, prefers it because it is easier, learned it from a self-instructor book, and likewise taught himself steel guitar.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: When did you get your guitar? Did you switch over then from banjo to guitar?
